english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something created or performed through improvisation.
Use 即興 when something is done or said without preparation, especially an improvised speech, performance, or remark.

examples.english: This improvisational performance is full of sparks.
examples.traditional: 呢場即興演出好有火花。
examples.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 zik1 hing3 jin2 ceot1 hou2 jau5 fo2 faa1

examples.english: The host suddenly asked me to go onstage, so I made a few spontaneous remarks.
examples.traditional: 主持突然叫我上台，我即興講咗幾句。
